queries_run: Centrus Energy customer credit risk utility customer bankruptcy OR downgrade 2026

findings.claim: 2025年前十大核燃料客戶占總營收約77%，前兩大客戶約31%；客戶減購或財務狀況變化可能影響業績。
findings.excerpt: In 2025, our ten largest nuclear fuel customers represented approximately 77% of total revenue and our two largest customers represented approximately 31% of total revenue.

findings.claim: 2025年客戶A/B/C/D分別占總營收約16%/15%/13%/11%；2024年客戶A 20%、B 13%；單一最大客戶占比由20%降至16%。
findings.excerpt: Revenue from Customers A, B, C, and D represented approximately 16%, 15%, 13%, and 11%, respectively, of total revenue for the year ended December 31, 2025.

findings.claim: 公司依各客戶財務狀況評估授信並定期監控信用風險；搜尋未見2026年客戶破產或信用降評事件。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 附註（信用風險集中）
findings.excerpt: Extension of credit is based on an evaluation of each customer’s financial condition. Centrus regularly monitors credit risk exposure and takes steps intended to mitigate the likelihood of such exposure resulting in a loss.

customer_concentration_credit.note: 未搜到特定客戶破產/降評/下修指引之來源；客戶多為公用事業核電業者。
